value.syntax: # [doc = " The ten alternatives of `type2`."] # [derive (Clone , Debug)] pub (crate) enum Type2Kind { # [doc = " `value`: a literal."] Value (Value) , # [doc = " `typename [genericarg]`: a reference to a type rule."] Typename { # [doc = " The referenced name."] name : Name , # [doc = " Generic arguments, when the reference instantiates them."] args : Option < GenericArgs > , } , # [doc = " `\"(\" S type S \")\"`: a parenthesized type."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Kept as its own node rather than unwrapped, because dropping the"] # [doc = " parentheses would change how the printed form reparses around a"] # [doc = " range or control operator."] Parenthesized (Box < Type >) , # [doc = " `\"{\" S group S \"}\"`: a map."] Map (Group) , # [doc = " `\"[\" S group S \"]\"`: an array."] Array (Group) , # [doc = " `\"~\" S typename [genericarg]`: unwrapping a tag or a wrapped group."] Unwrap { # [doc = " The name being unwrapped."] name : Name , # [doc = " Generic arguments, when the reference instantiates them."] args : Option < GenericArgs > , } , # [doc = " `\"&\" S \"(\" S group S \")\"`: the enumeration of an inline group."] EnumInline (Box < Group >) , # [doc = " `\"&\" S groupname [genericarg]`: the enumeration of a named group."] EnumGroup { # [doc = " The referenced group name."] name : Name , # [doc = " Generic arguments, when the reference instantiates them."] args : Option < GenericArgs > , } , # [doc = " `\"#\" \"6\" [\".\" uint] \"(\" S type S \")\"`: a tagged type."] Tagged { # [doc = " The tag number, absent for `#6(...)`, which tags with any"] # [doc = " number."] number : Option < Uint > , # [doc = " The type inside the tag."] inner : Box < Type > , } , # [doc = " `\"#\" DIGIT [\".\" uint]`: a major type, optionally with additional"] # [doc = " information."] Representation { # [doc = " The major type, 0 through 9 as the grammar's `DIGIT` allows."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " CBOR defines only 0 through 7; the grammar admits 8 and 9, and"] # [doc = " the parser admits what the grammar admits."] major : u8 , # [doc = " The additional information, when one was written."] ai : Option < Uint > , } , # [doc = " `\"#\"`: any data item."] Any , }
